query: UPDATE agents SET database_backup_enabled = $2, database_dump_dir = $3, database_selection = COALESCE($4, agents.database_selection), database_kubernetes_enabled = $5, database_kubeconfig_path = $6, database_docker_enabled = $7, database_docker_socket = $8, database_host_enabled = $9, database_host_os_user = $10, database_host_socket_dir = $11, database_host_port = $12, database_host_bin_dir = $13 WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
